page.overview:
Who is Darius Bowman?

Darius Bowman, often called "D" and affectionately nicknamed "Dino-Nerd", is the main protagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and its sequel series Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

In winter of 2015, he came to Isla Nublar after winning the opportunity to participate in Jurassic World's Camp Cretaceous after beating the Jurassic World VR video game. During his time on the island, he becomes the elected leader of the Nublar Six and later ends up becoming the adoptive brother of Kenji Kon. He was 12 (later 13) years old during the events of Camp Cretaceous and is 19 years old during the events of Chaos Theory. He is voiced by Paul-Mikél Williams.

Darius was born sometime in 2003. He is the second son of Fredrick and Mrs. Bowman, as well as the younger brother of Brandon Bowman.

Having grown up in a world where previously extinct dinosaurs lived and breathed, Darius developed a deep interest and admiration for these magnificent beings. This fascination was shared with his father (who most likely also influenced him), which made them have a fairly close relationship. Among other things, they enjoyed reading articles related to research and paleontological findings, especially those related to the doctor of paleontology Alan Grant. But the true dream of Darius and his father was to visit the Jurassic World theme park on Isla Nublar. They promised each other to visit the park and exchanged gifts to indicate their intention to do so.
